Headline: #156 LaSalle Temporary Northbound Reroute near Belmont/Halsted
ShortDescription: Northbound #156 LaSalle buses are temporarily rerouted: due to, a festival near Belmont/Halsted.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #156 LaSalle buses are temporarily rerouted via Belmont, Halsted, Addison, and Inner Lake Shore, due to a festival near Belmont/Halsted.

Southbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
